Is the Quran preserved?

How the Quran has been transmitted, and how that can be checked.

The case

Is the Quran preserved and authentic?

Unlike other scriptures, the Quran claims to be unchanged since its revelation. Can that be verified?

How the Quran was preserved

The Quran is the only religious text memorized completely by millions of people across every generation. Any copy can be verified against any memorizer anywhere on earth.

Read more

The oldest Quran manuscripts — like the Sana'a manuscript discovered in Yemen in 1972 — align perfectly with the Quran used today.

Our answer

The Quran has uniquely verifiable preservation.

The manuscript evidence

The Sana'a manuscripts date to within decades of the Prophet's ﷺ death and match the Quran used today with no substantive differences.
